summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Shaili Chopra, an Indian broadcast journalist. It covers her birth in Jalandhar, Punjab, and her family, including her father Anil Chopra, a retired Indian Air Force fighter pilot. It also describes her schooling, her master's degree in Broadcast and Television, her BBC broadcast training, and her work at CNBC, NDTV and ETNOW.
one_line: Biography of Indian broadcast journalist Shaili Chopra, covering her family, education and television news career.
key_facts: Shaili Chopra was born in Jalandhar, Punjab, on 21 July 1981.
Shaili Chopra's parents are Anil and Suman.
Anil Chopra is a retired fighter pilot from the Indian Air Force.
In 1998, Shaili Chopra finished her schooling from the Air Force Golden Jubilee Institute, New Delhi.
Shaili Chopra finished her master's degree in Broadcast and Television from the 2002 batch of The Asian College of Journalism, Chennai.
Shaili Chopra trained in broadcast with the BBC at journalism school.
Shaili Chopra has worked at CNBC.
Shaili Chopra has worked at NDTV.
Shaili Chopra has worked at ETNOW.
